fullPassage:
Bull Market vs. Bear Market

Stock market movement can be divided into two major trends: bull market vs. bear market.

BULL MARKET
A bull market is a rising stock market situation in which economic conditions are favorable to investors. They include high employment rates, GDP increases, and other positive economic indicators. Think of a charging bull in a field raising its horns. In a bull market, investors often believe in the market's present and future performance. As such, they increase their stock purchases and maintain their investments.

BEAR MARKET
Like a standing bear having lowered its front legs, a bear market implies a decline in stock values. It occurs when economic conditions are not favorable, and most stocks experience decreases in value. Factors like low GDP growth, rising unemployment, and low wages are possible conditions for a bear market. In difficult economic situations, investors frequently have negative views of the stock market, which may lead them to sell their stocks.

questions.passage: A bull market is a rising stock market situation in which economic conditions are (A)[favorable / unfavorable] to investors. They include high employment rates, GDP increases, and other (B)[positive / negative] economic indicators. In a bull market, investors often believe in the market's present and future performance. As such, they increase their stock purchases and (C)[maintain / abandon] their investments.
questions.stem: (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 경제적 조건이 투자자에게 유리한(favorable). 긍정적(positive) 경제 지표. 투자를 유지한다(maintain).
det.analysis:
✅ ① favorable–positive–maintain: 모두 원문 적합
❌ ② unfavorable: 강세장은 유리한 조건
❌ ③ negative: 강세장의 경제 지표는 긍정적
❌ ④ abandon: 강세장에서 투자를 포기하지 않음
det.tip: favorable(유리한) ↔ unfavorable(불리한) / maintain(유지하다) ↔ abandon(포기하다)

questions.passage: Like a standing bear having lowered its front legs, a bear market implies a (A)[decline / rise] in stock values. It occurs when economic conditions are not (B)[favorable / unfavorable], and most stocks experience decreases in value. In difficult economic situations, investors frequently have negative views of the stock market, which may lead them to (C)[sell / buy] their stocks.
questions.stem: (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 주식 가치의 하락(decline). 경제적 조건이 호의적이지 않은(not favorable). 주식을 매도(sell).
det.analysis:
✅ ④ decline–unfavorable–sell: 약세장의 특성 모두 적합. (B)는 'not favorable'이므로 'not unfavorable'이 아닌 'not favorable' = unfavorable이 맞음
❌ ①②③: 각각 하나 이상 부적합
det.tip: bear market: decline(하락) + not favorable(불리한) + sell(매도) / (B)는 not ___이므로 favorable이 정답

questions.passage: Stock market movement can be (A)[divided / combined] into two major trends: bull market vs. bear market. Like a standing bear having lowered its front legs, a bear market (B)[implies / denies] a decline in stock values. In difficult economic situations, investors (C)[frequently / constantly] have negative views of the stock market.
questions.stem: (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① divided–implies–frequently: 모두 원문 그대로 적합
❌ ② combined(합치다)는 divided(나누다)의 반의어
❌ ③ denies(부정하다)는 implies(암시하다)의 반대 뉘앙스
❌ ④ constantly(끊임없이)는 frequently(자주)와 유사하지만 원문은 frequently
det.tip: divided into(~로 구분하다) ↔ combined into(~로 합치다) / implies(암시하다) ↔ denies(부정하다)

questions.passage: A bull market is a ①<u>rising</u> stock market situation in which economic conditions are ②<u>favorable</u> to investors. They include high ③<u>unemployment</u> rates, GDP increases, and other positive economic indicators. In a bull market, investors often believe in the market's present and future ④<u>performance</u>.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ③ unemployment(실업) → employment(고용): 강세장은 '높은 고용률'이 특징. unemployment rates가 높으면 약세장
❌ ①②④: 모두 원문 그대로 적절
det.tip: employment(고용) ↔ unemployment(실업) / 강세장: high employment rates(높은 고용률)

questions.passage: Like a standing bear having lowered its front legs, a bear market implies a ①<u>decline</u> in stock values. It occurs when economic conditions are not favorable, and most stocks experience ②<u>increases</u> in value. Factors like low GDP growth, rising unemployment, and low ③<u>wages</u> are possible conditions for a bear market. In difficult economic situations, investors frequently have ④<u>negative</u> views of the stock market.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ② increases(증가) → decreases(감소): 약세장에서 주식은 가치 '감소'를 경험함
❌ ①③④: 모두 원문 그대로 적절
det.tip: decreases(감소) ↔ increases(증가) / 약세장: 주식 가치 하락

questions.passage: Stock market movement can be divided into two ①<u>major</u> trends: bull market vs. bear market. A bull market is a rising stock market situation. Think of a ②<u>charging</u> bull in a field raising its ③<u>horns</u>. In a bull market, investors often believe in the market's present and future performance. As such, they ④<u>decrease</u> their stock purchases and maintain their investments.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ④ decrease(줄이다) → increase(늘리다): 강세장에서 투자자는 주식 매입을 '늘리고' 투자를 유지
❌ ①②③: 모두 원문 그대로 적절
det.tip: increase(늘리다) ↔ decrease(줄이다) / 강세장: 매입 증가 + 투자 유지

questions.passage: A bull market is a rising stock market situation in which economic conditions are __________ to investors. They include high employment rates, GDP increases, and other positive economic indicators. Think of a charging bull in a field raising its horns. In a bull market, investors often believe in the market's present and future performance.
questions.stem: 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ② favorable(유리한): rising market + positive indicators → 유리한 조건
❌ ① unfavorable: 강세장에 부적합
❌ ③ neutral: 상승하는 시장에 '중립'은 부적합
❌ ④ uncertain: 명확한 상승장
det.tip: favorable = 유리한, 호의적인 / favorable conditions = 유리한 조건

questions.passage: Stock market movement can be divided into two major trends: bull market vs. bear market. Like a standing bear having lowered its front legs, a bear market implies a __________ in stock values. It occurs when economic conditions are not favorable, and most stocks experience decreases in value. Factors like low GDP growth, rising unemployment, and low wages are possible conditions for a bear market. In difficult economic situations, investors frequently have negative views of the stock market.
questions.stem: 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① decline(하락): decreases in value, low GDP growth 등 부정적 맥락
❌ ② increase: 약세장과 모순
❌ ③ stability: 변동이 있으므로 부적합
❌ ④ recovery: 회복이 아닌 하락 상황
det.tip: decline = 하락, 감소 / imply a decline = 하락을 암시하다

questions.passage: A bull market is a rising stock market situation in which economic conditions are favorable to investors. They include high employment rates, GDP increases, and other positive economic __________. Think of a charging bull in a field raising its horns. In a bull market, investors often believe in the market's present and future performance.
questions.stem: 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 높은 고용률, GDP 증가, 기타 긍정적 경제 지표(indicators).
det.analysis:
✅ ③ indicators(지표): employment rates, GDP increases와 같은 측정 가능한 수치 = 경제 지표
❌ ① trends: trends는 추세이지 개별 수치 아님
❌ ② conditions: 앞에서 conditions 이미 언급, 여기서는 구체적 수치
❌ ④ investments: 투자와 무관한 맥락
det.tip: economic indicators = 경제 지표 (GDP, 고용률 등 측정 가능한 경제 수치)

questions.passage: A bull market is a rising stock market situation in which economic conditions are <u>favorable</u> to investors. They include high employment rates, GDP increases, and other positive economic indicators.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 favorable과 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ④ advantageous(유리한): favorable과 동의어
❌ ① disadvantageous(불리한): 반의어
❌ ② harmful(해로운): 반의어 뉘앙스
❌ ③ hostile(적대적인): 반의어
det.tip: favorable ≈ advantageous ≈ beneficial / ↔ unfavorable, disadvantageous

questions.passage: Like a standing bear having lowered its front legs, a bear market <u>implies</u> a decline in stock values. It occurs when economic conditions are not favorable, and most stocks experience decreases in value.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 implies와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ③ suggests(시사하다): implies와 동의어
❌ ① states(명시하다): 암시가 아닌 직접 진술
❌ ② causes(야기하다): 인과 관계가 아닌 암시
❌ ④ prevents(방지하다): 반대 의미
det.tip: imply ≈ suggest ≈ hint at / ↔ state(명시하다), declare(선언하다)

questions.passage: In difficult economic situations, investors <u>frequently</u> have negative views of the stock market, which may lead them to sell their stocks.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 frequently와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ② often(자주): frequently와 동의어
❌ ① rarely(드물게): 반의어
❌ ③ never(결코 ~않다): 반의어
❌ ④ barely(거의 ~않다): 반의어
det.tip: frequently ≈ often ≈ regularly / ↔ rarely, seldom, never

questions.passage: They include high employment rates, GDP increases, and other <u>positive</u> economic indicators. Think of a charging bull in a field raising its horns. In a bull market, investors often believe in the market's present and future performance.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 positive와 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① pessimistic(비관적): positive(긍정적)의 반의어 뉘앙스
❌ ② hopeful(희망적): positive의 유사어
❌ ③ confident(확신하는): positive의 유사어
❌ ④ supportive(지지하는): positive의 유사어
det.tip: positive(긍정적) ↔ negative, pessimistic / hopeful, confident는 유사어 함정

questions.passage: In a bull market, investors often believe in the market's present and future performance. As such, they increase their stock purchases and <u>maintain</u> their investments.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 maintain과 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ④ abandon(포기하다): maintain(유지하다)의 반의어
❌ ① keep(유지하다): 유사어
❌ ② preserve(보존하다): 유사어
❌ ③ sustain(지속하다): 유사어
det.tip: maintain ≈ keep ≈ preserve ≈ sustain / maintain ↔ abandon(포기), give up

questions.passage:
(A) Like a standing <u>bear</u> having lowered its front legs, a bear market implies a decline in stock values.

(B) A <u>bear</u> market occurs when economic conditions are not favorable, and most stocks experience decreases in value. Factors like low GDP growth, rising unemployment, and low wages are possible conditions.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 bear가 (A)와 (B)에서 의미하는 바로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ② (A) 곰(동물 비유) – (B) 약세의(금융 용어): (A)는 서 있는 곰의 비유, (B)는 하락장을 뜻하는 금융 용어
❌ ① 의미 뒤바뀜
❌ ③ 견디다/지탱하다는 문맥 부적합
❌ ④ 동물/참다는 문맥 부적합
det.tip: bear: (동물) 곰 → 비유적으로 약세장 / bear market = 곰이 앞발을 내리는 모습 → 하락장

questions.passage:
Bull Market vs. Bear Market

Stock market movement can be divided into two major trends: bull market vs. bear market. BULL MARKET
A bull market is a rising stock market situation in which economic conditions are favorable to investors.
questions.stem:
다음 영영 풀이에 해당하는 단어를 고르시오.
"A general direction in which something is developing or changing"

det.analysis:
✅ ③ trend(추세): '발전/변화의 방향'이라는 정의에 정확히 부합
❌ ① stock(주식): 방향과 무관
❌ ② profit(이윤): 방향과 무관
❌ ④ investment(투자): 행위이지 방향 아님
det.tip: trend = 추세, 경향 / 'bull market vs. bear market'은 두 가지 major trends

questions.passage: Like a standing bear having lowered its front legs, a bear market implies a decline in stock values. Factors like low GDP growth, __________ (rise) unemployment, and low wages are possible conditions for a bear market.
questions.stem: 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오.

det.analysis:
✅ rising: 명사 unemployment를 수식하는 현재분사(형용사) 필요
'rising unemployment' = 증가하는 실업
det.tip: rise → rising(현재분사/형용사): 증가하는 / 현재분사의 형용사 용법

questions.passage: A bull market is a rising stock market situation. In a bull market, __________ (economy) conditions are favorable to investors. They include high employment rates and GDP increases.
questions.stem: 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오.

det.analysis:
✅ economic: 명사 conditions를 수식하는 형용사 필요
economy(명사: 경제) → economic(형용사: 경제적인)
det.tip: economy(명사: 경제) → economic(형용사: 경제적인) → economically(부사)

det.analysis:

❌ ② negative views: 강세장에서 부정적 견해는 약세장 특성

It occurs when economic conditions are not favorable, and most stocks experience decreases in value. Factors like low GDP growth, rising unemployment, and low wages are possible conditions for a bear market. In difficult economic situations, investors frequently have negative views of the stock market, __________.
questions.stem: 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 부정적 견해가 그들을 주식 매도로 이끌 수 있다(which may lead them to sell their stocks).
det.analysis:
✅ ① which may lead them to sell: 약세장 + negative views → 매도. 관계대명사절로 부정적 견해의 결과 서술
❌ ② buy more: 약세장에서 추가 매수는 부적합
❌ ③ increase investments: 약세장에서 투자 증가는 비합리적
❌ ④ enter the market: 시장 진입 동기 없음
det.tip: bear market: not favorable → negative views → sell stocks / lead A to B = A가 B하게 이끌다
